name: unm-plugin-lancom-sx
description: UnifiedNetworkManager plugin: Lancom SX-Series switch monitoring (system/PSU/fans/temperature, ports + throughput, PoE, LAG/LACP) + network/host inventory over the LCOS-SX MIBs (unified 4.x tree and legacy GS-2310 3.x tree), with config/planning actions via SNMP SET.
